verses.pali: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Mendicants, a lay follower with five qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.
They kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, lie, and consume beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: A lay follower with these five qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato upāsako yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge.
verses.english: A lay follower with five qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti …pe… surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato hoti.
verses.english: They don’t kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, lie, or consume beer, wine, and liquor intoxicants.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato upāsako yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge”ti.
verses.english: A lay follower with these five qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.”
